name: Handle an impasse without escalation
short_description: Handle an impasse without escalation once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can handle an impasse without escalation in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Handle an impasse without escalation means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Handle an impasse without escalation in a fresh real-life scenario.
